items.title: Formalizing inverse problems in the age of AI: possibilities, pitfalls, and an invitation
items.titleZh: 人工智能时代逆问题的形式化：可能性、陷阱和邀请
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.06962v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Proof assistants such as Lean check mathematical proofs down to the axioms, and AI agents have recently made writing such proofs cheap. We describe AutoIP, a Lean library in which classical linear regularization theory, together with the functional analysis it rests on, has been autoformalized by AI agents. A machine-checked proof certifies only the formal statement it proves, so the remaining human task is to confirm that each formal statement says what was intended. We organize the library around this task: a reviewer compares the formal statements with their natural-language counterparts and never needs to read a proof. Our experience is that the risks lie in the statements rather than in the proofs, and that simple automated tests on the statements can expose problems even in the established literature. We illustrate this with a textbook theorem whose hypothesis is more restrictive than asserted. We invite the inverse problems community to extend and build on the library.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.06962v1 公告类型：新
摘要：像 Lean 这样的证明助手可以检查数学证明直至公理，而人工智能代理最近使得编写此类证明变得便宜。我们描述了 AutoIP，一个精益库，其中经典的线性正则化理论及其所依赖的功能分析已由人工智能代理自动形式化。经过机器检查的证明仅证明其所证明的正式陈述，因此剩下的人工任务是确认每个正式陈述都表达了其意图。我们围绕这个任务组织库：审阅者将正式陈述与自然语言对应物进行比较，并且不需要阅读证明。我们的经验是，风险在于陈述而不是证明，并且对陈述进行简单的自动化测试甚至可以暴露现有文献中的问题。我们用一个教科书定理来说明这一点，该定理的假设比断言更具限制性。我们邀请反问题社区来扩展和构建该库。
items.author: Christian Clason, Tapio Helin, Medet Nursultanov, Lauri Oksanen

items.title: KDASO: Knowledge-Data Dual-Driven Automated Skill Optimization for Liability Adjudication Tasks
items.titleZh: KDASO：知识数据双驱动责任审判任务自动化技能优化
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.06972v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Liability adjudication tasks (e.g., legal charge determination) require analyzing event descriptions against domain-specific skills to determine whether a party should bear liability. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise in this area by leveraging executable skills for interpretable reasoning, existing approaches face three critical limitations: skill libraries become stale as real-world scenarios dynamically evolve, skill descriptions often suffer from a semantic execution gap where LLMs deviate from intended expert logic, and growing skill collections exceed context budgets causing critical skill omission. To address these challenges, we propose Knowledge-Data Dual-Driven Automated Skill Optimization (KDASO), which continuously evolves a skill library through neighborhood-conditioned induction from recent adjudication data, execution-aligned refinement based on LLM trajectory analysis, and context-budgeted routing for scalable skill selection. Experiments across ride-hailing adjudication, legal liability determination, and logical reasoning judgment demonstrate that KDASO significantly outperforms current general-purpose and domain-specific baselines. KDASO further achieves 8.96% improvement when transferring skills to concept-similar scenarios and maintains consistent performance gains through continuous optimization, underscoring the high transferability and stability of generated skills.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.06972v1 公告类型：新
摘要：责任裁决任务（例如，法律指控确定）需要根据特定领域的技能分析事件描述，以确定当事人是否应该承担责任。虽然大型语言模型 (LLM) 通过利用可执行技能进行可解释推理，在该领域显示出前景，但现有方法面临三个关键限制：随着现实世界场景的动态发展，技能库会变得陈旧；技能描述经常会遇到语义执行差距，其中 LLM 偏离预期的专家逻辑；不断增长的技能集合超出了上下文预算，导致关键技能遗漏。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了知识数据双驱动自动技能优化（KDASO），它通过最近裁决数据的邻域条件归纳、基于法学硕士轨迹分析的执行对齐细化以及用于可扩展技能选择的上下文预算路由来不断发展技能库。网约车裁决、法律责任判定和逻辑推理判断等方面的实验表明，KDASO 的性能显着优于当前的通用和特定领域基线。 KDASO 在将技能迁移到概念相似的场景时进一步实现了 8.96% 的提升，并通过持续优化保持一致的性能增益，强调了生成技能的高可迁移性和稳定性。

items.title: BlockLock: Reproducible LLM Inference with Fixed Batch Geometry
items.titleZh: BlockLock：具有固定批量几何形状的可重复 LLM 推理
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.06977v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Reproducible LLM inference requires that a request produces the same output regardless of the other requests in the batch. Existing solutions pay for this in different ways: batch-invariant kernels constrain every operator, and isolating prefill with fixed-shape decode ({our CoRun-style baseline}) gives up shared prefill compute and pads decode. We present BlockLock, which keeps shared batched prefill and pins only the numerical path of the protected request: it fixes the geometry that the request sees, with {two modes: BlockLock-Rows uses fixed-width rows and retains batched decode of all requests; BlockLock-Pack uses terminal-anchored packing with an isolated dummy segment, then extracts the protected request's KV state for target-only decode. Under a stated per-deployment contract, both modes preserve the target's output bitwise when its companions change.} Across five {dense} models (Qwen3-8B/14B, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and Gemma-3-4B/12B-IT) and three single-GPU deployments (NVIDIA A6000, A100, and H100), we evaluate our approach on both tinyBenchmarks and BFCL{; we also include initial tensor-parallel experiments on two NVIDIA A6000 GPUs. Both modes preserve target sequences and Top20-logit bits in the reported tests.} At equal delivered work, {BlockLock-Rows} reduces latency by 53.5--55.0\% and improves throughput by 115.2--122.2\% relative to vLLM Batch-Invariant; compared with batch-invariant kernels, it needs no custom kernel implementations and constrains only the protected requests.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.06977v1 公告类型：新
摘要：可重现的 LLM 推理要求请求生成相同的输出，而不管批次中的其他请求如何。现有的解决方案以不同的方式为此付出代价：批量不变的内核限制每个运算符，并且使用固定形状解码（{我们的 CoRun 风格基线}）隔离预填充，放弃共享预填充计算和填充解码。我们提出了 BlockLock，它保持共享批量预填充并仅固定受保护请求的数字路径：它通过两种模式修复请求看到的几何形状：BlockLock-Rows 使用固定宽度的行并保留所有请求的批量解码； BlockLock-Pack 使用具有隔离虚拟段的终端锚定打包，然后提取受保护请求的 KV 状态以进行仅目标解码。根据规定的每次部署合同，两种模式都会在同伴发生变化时按位保留目标的输出。}在五个{dense}模型（Qwen3-8B/14B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 Gemma-3-4B/12B-IT）和三个单 GPU 部署（NVIDIA A6000、A100 和 H100）中，我们在tinyBenchmarks 和tinyBenchmarks 上评估了我们的方法。 BFCL{;我们还包括在两个 NVIDIA A6000 GPU 上进行的初始张量并行实验。两种模式都在报告的测试中保留目标序列和 Top20-logit 位。} 在同等交付的工作量下，相对于 vLLM Batch-Invariant，{BlockLock-Rows} 将延迟减少了 53.5--55.0\%，并将吞吐量提高了 115.2--122.2\%；与批量不变内核相比，它不需要自定义内核实现，并且仅约束受保护的请求。
items.author: Xiuyuan Qi, Pedro Reviriego, Javier Conde, Shanshan Liu

items.title: Resource-Efficient Reinforcement Learning Post-Training through Elastic Expert Parallelism
items.titleZh: 通过弹性专家并行进行训练后资源高效的强化学习
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.06984v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Reinforcement learning post-training improves the capabilities of large language models, but generating training responses is a major computational bottleneck. In mixture-of-experts models, workers that finish their assigned responses may remain occupied because their experts are still needed by workers processing longer responses. Consequently, approximately one-third of occupied worker time in the baseline occurs after local response generation finishes. Here we present FlexFloor, a system that enables earlier resource release during synchronous response generation while preserving the expert computation required by ongoing responses. FlexFloor jointly adapts response scheduling and the active group of workers. It uses historical response lengths and memory constraints to guide batching and prompt placement, then progressively releases workers while maintaining expert availability and correct communication. Compared with the verl baseline, FlexFloor generates approximately 65.40% more response tokens per unit of occupied computing time and increases response generation throughput by 52.74%, with little observed variation in rollout reward. By making reinforcement learning post-training more efficient, FlexFloor supports faster development and iterative improvement of large language models and AI agents.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.06984v1 公告类型：新
摘要：强化学习后训练提高了大型语言模型的能力，但生成训练响应是一个主要的计算瓶颈。在专家混合模型中，完成分配的响应的工作人员可能会继续忙碌，因为处理较长响应的工作人员仍然需要他们的专家。因此，基线中大约三分之一的占用工作时间发生在本地响应生成完成之后。在这里，我们介绍 FlexFloor，这是一个系统，可以在同步响应生成过程中更早地释放资源，同时保留正在进行的响应所需的专家计算。 FlexFloor 共同调整响应调度和活跃的工作人员组。它使用历史响应长度和内存限制来指导批处理和提示放置，然后逐步释放工作人员，同时保持专家的可用性和正确的通信。与 verl 基线相比，FlexFloor 每单位占用计算时间生成的响应令牌增加了约 65.40%，响应生成吞吐量增加了 52.74%，而首次部署奖励几乎没有观察到变化。通过使强化学习训练后更加高效，FlexFloor 支持大型语言模型和 AI 代理的更快开发和迭代改进。

items.title: The Two-Ledger Model: Transaction-Grain Cost Accounting for Multi-Agent AI Systems Across Clouds, Models, and Systems of Record
items.titleZh: 二账本模型：跨云、模型和记录系统的多代理人工智能系统的交易粒度成本核算
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.06989v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Enterprises run business transactions through multi-agent AI systems spanning clouds, large language models (LLMs), orchestration harnesses, and systems of record. Finance receives AI cost only at settlement grain, aggregated by SKU and charge period. The business question (what did this order, claim, or case cost in AI?) cannot be answered from billing data, because providers never see enterprise transaction boundaries. We formalize this grain mismatch, derive seven requirements, and propose the Two-Ledger Model: a settlement ledger of FOCUS-conformant billing data joined to an attribution ledger of invocation-grain usage records built on OpenTelemetry GenAI telemetry. A layered correlation spine (trace context, A2A/MCP metadata, business-key correlation, probabilistic matching) assigns each record to its business transaction with recorded method and confidence; a versioned rate card prices usage in near real time; period reconciliation ties both ledgers to the invoice, and the unexplained residual identifies shadow AI. Costs are reported per order, claim, or outcome with agentic cost metrics. A simulation with known ground truth shows the spine sustaining cost coverage above 99% as trace propagation falls to zero, the reconciliation residual recovering planted unmetered spend within 0.24 percentage points while flagging provider billing errors, and mid-flight gating cutting p99 transaction cost by up to 61% at a 2-4% false-pause rate. We propose the attribution ledger as an invocation-grain FOCUS profile for standardization.

items.title: Autonomous AI Agents Systematically Diverge From Human Preferences in Proof Formalization
items.titleZh: 自主人工智能代理在证明形式化方面系统地偏离人类偏好
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.06995v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems have ushered in a new age of proof abundance, but helping humans understand these proofs requires new attention to the differences in how AI agents and humans pursue a proof-making task. We present "simulated collaboration", a methodology that allows us to examine two key questions: (1) the relative attention AI agents pay to surface syntax or, conversely, deeper underlying semantics, and (2) how and where AI agent preferences for what to do next diverge from human preferences. On a set of nine major human collaborations in Lean with 4.7M definitions across more than 6K commits, we find that, over the course of proof construction, AI agents (1) are far more strongly drawn than humans to explicitly marked gaps; (2) show a relative aversion to densely connected proof centers and to complex or surprising proof goals; and (3) are relatively attracted to surprising proof bodies, which they tend to regularize toward baseline. Our results highlight important blind spots and potential interventions for future human-AI collaboration in mathematics.

items.title: Trust Responsive Runtime Authorization for Agentic AI with Empirical Characterization of Policy Behavior and Parameter Sensitivity
items.titleZh: 具有策略行为和参数敏感性经验特征的代理 AI 的信任响应式运行时授权
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.06996v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: The policy that converts runtime estimates of an autonomous agent's condition into operational authority is rarely specified or measured. We empirically characterize the Trust Responsive Authorization Policy (TRAP), which maps an Authorization Readiness Score (ARS), a weighted combination of runtime trust, operational stability, and contextual risk, onto discrete authorization levels through an asymmetric rule: escalation requires consecutive observations above a band edge plus a margin, while a sharp drop in readiness restricts authority at once. On one matched set of 100 Monte Carlo traces, we compare TRAP with static, trust-only, risk-only, and symmetric policies. Under abrupt degradation, TRAP restricts at onset and re-escalates sooner after recovery than the symmetric policy, with the highest and, descriptively, least variable stability among the adaptive policies, although more of its post-recovery escalations occur below the selected trust threshold. Paired bootstrap intervals exclude zero for the remaining differences. In one-factor sweeps, recovery time rises with the escalation margin and run length, shifts with the score weights, and is unchanged by the restriction threshold. In an exploratory post-freeze experiment, when the same degradation is spread over 5-20 intervals, TRAP restricts only on the 4 traces that retain a single-interval drop above that threshold; averaged over all 100 traces, it holds authority above what readiness supports for 15.9-18.9 of the 20 degradation intervals, against 0.8 under abrupt degradation and about 10 for the symmetric policy. Its restriction advantage therefore depends on degradation being abrupt. All reported values are traceable to the publicly available, versioned research release.

items.title: Adapting the Process of Adaptation: Darwinian, Lamarckian, and Agent-Directed Evolution in AI
items.titleZh: 适应适应过程：人工智能中的达尔文主义、拉马克主义和智能体定向进化
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.07048v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Evolution has shaped intelligence for billions of years. Artificial intelligence (AI) now raises a striking possibility: intelligence may begin to direct its own evolution. As AI agents become capable of modifying and evaluating their own behavior, how quickly could they improve, and how can that improvement remain safe? We develop a theoretical framework comparing Darwinian, Lamarckian, and agent-directed evolution following environmental change. Darwinian evolution relies on natural selection, Lamarckian evolution adds inherited learning, and agent-directed evolution allows agents to generate and evaluate behavioral variants and choose how extensively to search. When learning is sufficiently effective, these mechanisms exhibit progressively faster adaptation. Generating more variants accelerates adaptation, while optimal search effort depends on learning ability, problem difficulty, and experimentation costs. However, an agent's ability to direct its improvement does not ensure that improvements are evaluated against the intended objective. When the evaluation target is misspecified, additional search accelerates convergence toward the wrong behavior, even as measured performance improves. In recursive self-improvement, such errors may persist across generations, posing challenges for AI safety. Independent evaluation and oversight must keep pace with autonomous AI development. The central challenge is not simply to accelerate the evolution of intelligence, but to preserve humanity's ability to guide its direction, limit its speed, and intervene when necessary.

摘要：数十亿年来，进化塑造了智力。人工智能（AI）现在提出了一个惊人的可能性：智能可能开始引导自己的进化。随着人工智能代理变得能够修改和评估自己的行为，它们能够多快地改进，以及这种改进如何保持安全？我们开发了一个理论框架，比较达尔文主义、拉马克主义和环境变化后的主体导向进化。达尔文进化论依赖于自然选择，拉马克进化论增加了遗传学习，而代理导向进化允许代理生成和评估行为变异，并选择搜索范围。当学习足够有效时，这些机制会表现出逐渐更快的适应能力。生成更多变体可以加速适应，而最佳搜索工作取决于学习能力、问题难度和实验成本。然而，代理指导其改进的能力并不能确保根据预期目标评估改进。当评估目标指定错误时，即使测量到的性能有所提高，额外的搜索也会加速向错误行为的收敛。在递归的自我改进中，此类错误可能会持续几代人，给人工智能安全带来挑战。独立评估和监督必须跟上自主人工智能的发展。核心挑战不仅仅是加速智能的进化，而是保持人类引导其方向、限制其速度以及在必要时进行干预的能力。

items.title: Closed-Loop Agent Evaluation: Layered Measurement and Self-Calibration
items.titleZh: 闭环代理评估：分层测量和自校准
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.07051v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Once an agent is live, teams want to know whether it is doing its job, not just whether it throws errors. Yet most evaluation is one-off: a benchmark run, a look at traces, a single score. Its conclusions neither check themselves nor reach the agent. We propose closed-loop evaluation, an evaluation method for deployed agents. It models evaluation as performance estimation under biased raters and censored outcomes, and it requires every level's conclusion to trace back to atomic data and to be computed by versioned rules. The method covers four levels of analysis (span, trace, conversation and engagement), measures along a spine of Execution, Substance, Trajectory and Results, treats Conduct as a constraint throughout, and uses Provenance and Adjudication components to certify the evidence and the evaluators. Evaluator agents generated by an Agent Factory carry these components, each with a domain knowledge pack and an adapter harness. Two loops close the evaluation: an inner loop audits the evidence, rules and metrics themselves, and an outer loop uses per-component regression checks to drive agent improvement. We also give a pipeline that runs this process automatically. Using the business-analysis agent SharpInsight as a case and porting the method to public conversation data, we show how problems differ across levels and how evidence-and-rule judgment is more reliable than holistic scoring (ICC 0.86 vs. 0.81; kappa 0.81 vs. 0.63).

items.title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning via Epigraph-Form Guided Exploration
items.titleZh: 通过铭文形式引导探索的协作多智能体强化学习
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.07066v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Discovering cooperative behavior in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is challenging due to the combinatorial complexity of joint state-action spaces, which hinders the emergence of coordinated behaviors from trial-and-error alone. Intrinsic rewards are often used to aid discovery, but naively combining them with team objectives can distort the learning signal, compromising task performance. In this paper, we propose EFXPLORER, a constrained exploration framework that maximizes exploration objectives subject to a constraint that preserves established task performance. We solve the resulting problem using an epigraph reformulation that introduces adaptive exploration budgets. This approach separates intrinsic rewards from task objectives and regulates exploration through task feasibility. To further encourage diverse and temporally extended exploration, we incorporate a successor distance-based intrinsic reward that captures long-horizon dependencies. Empirically, our method outperforms strong baselines and induces novel cooperative strategies across SMAX, VMAS, and MPE benchmark suites.

items.title: When Verification Is Not Agreement: Cross-Agent LLM-to-Dafny Formalization
items.titleZh: 当验证不一致时：跨代理 LLM 到 Dafny 形式化
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.07073v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: A verified Dafny postcondition certifies that a formula holds, but it does not guarantee that the result was reached through genuine independent reasoning. We introduce a cross-agent formalization protocol where a Specifier model translates clinical trial criteria into a Dafny predicate, and an Implementer model writes an operational method checked against it. A same-model control establishes that even with no capability gap, independent re-extraction from identical text agrees only 59.3% of the time. Evaluating four model configurations on 96 clinical trial documents, we find that agreement is highly sensitive to how model capability is allocated across the two roles: the GPT-4.1-nano/GPT-4.1-mini configuration achieves 53.0% agreement when the stronger model is the Implementer, but only 14.3% when the roles are reversed. The strongest tested configuration, GPT-5.6-luna/GPT-5.4-mini, improves agreement to 34.4% but remains below the same-model baseline and is dominated by direct contradiction (42.7%). We also detect a critical verification artifact in which a weaker Implementer satisfies the postcondition by invoking the Specifier's predicate directly; after structural auditing, corrected agreement falls from 14.3% to 13.2%. Our results show that verification success alone is insufficient evidence of independent cross-agent agreement, and that model capability does not guarantee agreement when formalizing the same source independently.

items.title: Synthesizing symbolic models of human and machine reasoning at scale
items.titleZh: 大规模综合人类和机器推理的符号模型
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.07088v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Symbolic models offer a powerful account of cognition, but their scope has historically been limited by the need for hand-engineering and computational tractability. We show how advances in artificial intelligence (AI) can scale symbolic modeling and help overcome these engineering limitations. We introduce Behavior-Conditioned Symbolic Synthesis (BCSS)---an approach for automated search of interpretable, deterministic symbolic programs that verifiably reproduce behavior---and apply it to model both human and machine behavior across hundreds of challenging reasoning problems. Analyzing these programs reveals that both people and machines tend to oversimplify, adopt rules that are partial explanations for their observations, and misinfer dependencies between problem features. These shared signatures are modulated by available resources, with reasoning effort predicting the extent to which machines simplify and explain their observations. Together, these results point to underlying mechanisms reminiscent of satisficing in both people and machines, and illustrate how BCSS offers a general approach for interpreting and comparing rule-based reasoning of humans and black-box AI systems.

arXiv:2611.07088v1 公告类型：新
摘要：符号模型提供了对认知的强大解释，但其范围历来受到手工工程和计算易处理性需求的限制。我们展示了人工智能 (AI) 的进步如何扩展符号建模并帮助克服这些工程限制。我们引入了行为条件符号综合（BCSS）——一种自动搜索可解释的、确定性符号程序的方法，可验证地再现行为——并将其应用于数百个具有挑战性的推理问题中的人类和机器行为建模。分析这些程序表明，人和机器都倾向于过于简单化，采用部分解释其观察结果的规则，并错误地推断问题特征之间的依赖关系。这些共享签名由可用资源进行调节，推理工作可以预测机器简化和解释其观察结果的程度。总之，这些结果指出了让人和机器都满意的潜在机制，并说明了 BCSS 如何提供一种通用方法来解释和比较人类和黑盒人工智能系统基于规则的推理。

items.title: PromptOps: Iterative Prompt Optimization for LLM-as-a-Judge Systems
items.titleZh: PromptOps：法学硕士法官系统的迭代提示优化
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.07123v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for evaluating the behavior of chatbots and other AI systems. In deployment, however, their agreement with the intended human evaluation policy may degrade as user interactions and score distributions change. Existing automatic prompt optimization methods are primarily studied as one-shot procedures on static development sets and therefore provide limited guidance for maintaining LLM judges over time. We frame this problem as judge drift and introduce PromptOps, a closedloop framework for monitoring and iteratively recalibrating LLM-as-a-Judge (LLMaaJ) systems. PromptOps separates four operational decisions: when to optimize, which optimization procedure to apply, which feedback records to use, and how to update the judge prompt. We instantiate the framework with five prompt optimization methods: GEPA, SIMBA, Rubric Synthesis, and exemplar selection using either simulated annealing or a Tree-structured Parzen Estimator. Our experiments demonstrate that iterative prompt optimization can recalibrate LLM judges and recover performance after controlled shifts in the referencescore distribution. However, effective maintenance is inherently contextdependent: neither optimization algorithm choice nor update timing generalizes universally across settings. These findings establish prompt optimization for deployed LLM judges as an inherently iterative maintenance problem and demonstrate that PromptOps provides a practical abstraction for studying and implementing this process.

arXiv:2611.07123v1 公告类型：新
摘要：大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用作评估聊天机器人和其他人工智能系统行为的自动法官。然而，在部署过程中，随着用户交互和分数分布的变化，它们与预期人类评估策略的一致性可能会降低。现有的自动提示优化方法主要是作为静态开发集上的一次性程序进行研究的，因此为随着时间的推移维持 LLM 法官提供的指导有限。我们将这个问题定义为法官漂移，并引入 PromptOps，这是一个闭环框架，用于监控和迭代重新校准 LLM-as-a-Judge (LLMaaJ) 系统。 PromptOps 分离了四个操作决策：何时优化、应用哪个优化程序、使用哪些反馈记录以及如何更新判断提示。我们使用五种即时优化方法实例化该框架：GEPA、SIMBA、Rubric Synthesis 以及使用模拟退火或树结构 Parzen 估计器的样本选择。我们的实验表明，迭代提示优化可以重新校准 LLM 法官并在参考分数分布受控变化后恢复表现。然而，有效的维护本质上是依赖于上下文的：优化算法的选择和更新时间都不能普遍适用于所有设置。这些发现将部署的 LLM 法官的即时优化视为一个固有的迭代维护问题，并证明 PromptOps 为研究和实施此过程提供了实用的抽象。

items.title: Goal Revelation as a Bridge Between Information-Theoretic Empowerment and Capability-Based Human Power
items.titleZh: 目标揭示作为信息论赋权与基于能力的人力之间的桥梁
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.07247v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Power matters for AI safety. Optimal agents tend to acquire power across a wide range of objectives (instrumental convergence). As we embed AI agents into socio-technical systems, humans risk gradual disempowerment. Both concerns call for a formal, quantitative measure of power. Two such measures in the context of Markov games are information-theoretic empowerment, the capacity of the channel from an agent's actions to future states, and capability-based individual power, a measure of goal attainment built from the probabilities that a human would attain each goal in a family of candidates were they pursuing it. We show where the two meet. From individual power, Fano's inequality yields a floor $B(s)$. This floor is a lower bound on what we term goal revelation, the mutual information $\mathbb{I}(G;\xi \mid s)$ between the human's latent goal and the realised trajectory. Empowerment caps revelation from above, so that $B(s) \le \mathbb{I}(G;\xi \mid s) \le \mathbb{I}(\mathbf{A}_h \to \xi \mid s) \le \mathfrak{E}_h(s)$. Each quantity can be large while the one below it stays at zero, highlighting the following failure modes. An assistant maximising empowerment can prefer an interface offering broad influence over goal-irrelevant degrees of freedom to one that lets the human attain every goal they might hold. An assistant maximising revelation cannot tell a working interface from one rewired so that every goal yields the wrong outcome, since relabelling goals leaves mutual information unchanged while zeroing every attainment probability. Positive guarantees therefore come only from the attainment end of the chain. A satisfaction floor, computable from two statistics of interaction logs, offers a way to monitor the power users retain in a deployed system, and simulations in random environments show the three quantities are correlated but far from interchangeable.

arXiv:2611.07247v1 公告类型：新
摘要：功率对于人工智能安全至关重要。最佳代理倾向于在广泛的目标上获得权力（工具趋同）。当我们将人工智能嵌入到社会技术系统中时，人类面临着逐渐被剥夺权力的风险。这两个问题都需要对权力进行正式的、定量的衡量。马尔可夫博弈背景下的两个这样的衡量标准是信息论赋权，即从代理人的行为到未来状态的通道的能力，以及基于能力的个人权力，这是一种目标实现的衡量标准，是根据人类在追求目标时实现一系列候选者中的每个目标的概率而建立的。我们展示了两者相遇的地方。从个人权力来看，法诺的不平等产生了下限 $B(s)$。这个下限是我们所说的目标启示的下界，即人类潜在目标和已实现轨迹之间的互信息 $\mathbb{I}(G;\xi \mid s)$。授权限制了来自上面的启示，因此$B(s) \le \mathbb{I}(G;\xi \mid s) \le \mathbb{I}(\mathbf{A}_h \to \xi \mid s) \le \mathfrak{E}_h(s)$。每个数量可能很大，而其下方的数量则保持为零，突出显示以下故障模式。最大化授权的助理可能更喜欢对与目标无关的自由度提供广泛影响的界面，而不是让人们实现他们可能持有的每个目标的界面。最大化启示的助手无法区分工作界面和重新连接的界面，因此每个目标都会产生错误的结果，因为重新标记目标会导致相互信息保持不变，同时将每个实现概率归零。因此，积极的保证仅来自链条的实现端。满意度底线可以根据交互日志的两个统计数据计算出来，提供了一种监控已部署系统中保留的高级用户的方法，并且随机环境中的模拟显示这三个量是相关的，但远不能互换。

items.title: Robust Ranking of Port Impacts from Impending Tropical Cyclones: A Two-Stage Recommendation System
items.titleZh: 即将到来的热带气旋对港口影响的稳健排名：两阶段推荐系统
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.07296v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: When a tropical cyclone (TC) threatens several ports, preparedness planning depends on anticipating which ports are likely to be affected and where disruptions may last longest. Limited historical observations at individual ports and uncertainty in landfall location make these relative impacts difficult to estimate. We use a two-stage recommendation framework that first selects candidate ports based on their proximity to the expected landfall location and then ranks them by their estimated number of impact days. Using AIS-derived impact days for 37 ports and 31 TCs in the Gulf of Mexico study region, we compare three ways of representing port--cyclone interactions: pairwise feature interactions, tree-based feature combinations, and explicit feature crosses combined with learned embeddings. In tests on Hurricanes Nicole and Ian, the retrieval stage consistently identifies all observed affected ports under landfall uncertainty. Among the ranking models, Wide & Deep Learning achieves the closest agreement with the observed port rankings. Its mean ranking agreement exceeds that of the distance-based baseline by 85.5% for Nicole and 55.5% for Ian and is less sensitive to uncertainty in the landfall location. These rankings could help port authorities prioritize post-cyclone inspections and allocate recovery resources across ports threatened by the same event.

arXiv:2611.07296v1 公告类型：新
摘要：当热带气旋 (TC) 威胁多个港口时，准备计划取决于预测哪些港口可能受到影响以及哪些港口的干扰可能持续时间最长。各个港口的历史观测有限以及登陆位置的不确定性使得这些相对影响难以估计。我们使用两阶段推荐框架，首先根据候选港口与预期登陆位置的接近程度选择候选港口，然后根据估计的影响天数对它们进行排名。使用墨西哥湾研究区域 37 个港口和 31 个 TC 的 AIS 衍生影响天数，我们比较了表示港口与气旋相互作用的三种方法：成对特征相互作用、基于树的特征组合以及与学习嵌入相结合的显式特征交叉。在飓风妮可和伊恩的测试中，检索阶段一致地识别出所有观察到的在登陆不确定性下受影响的港口。在排名模型中，Wide & Deep Learning 与观察到的端口排名最为一致。 Nicole 的平均排名一致性比基于距离的基线高出 85.5%，Ian 的平均排名一致性比基于距离的基线高出 55.5%，并且对登陆位置的不确定性不太敏感。这些排名可以帮助港口当局确定飓风后检查的优先顺序，并在受同一事件威胁的港口之间分配恢复资源。

items.title: SteelAgent: LLM-Orchestrated, Physics-Informed Steel Property Prediction with Audited Generalization and Calibrated Uncertainty
items.titleZh: SteelAgent：法学硕士精心策划、基于物理的钢铁性能预测，具有经过审计的概括和校准的不确定性
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.06953v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Steel property models can perform well on random test splits even when they extrapolate poorly to unfamiliar alloys. SteelAgent couples metallurgical descriptors and machine-learning models with a language-model interface for property prediction, uncertainty reporting and inverse design. We examine how the choice of held-out unit changes the conclusions drawn from SteelBench tensile-strength evaluations. For gradient boosting, pooled out-of-fold $R^2$ fell from 0.859 on a random split to 0.113 when steel families were held out. Empirical coverage of nominal 90% prediction intervals ranged from 91.0% under random splitting to 37.6% on held-out sources. The effect of physics-derived features depended on the evaluation. They increased gradient-boosting $R^2$ by 0.2534 in a 17-family holdout analysis and decreased it by 0.358 in a separate four-grade laboratory analysis. We report group-level errors and a synthetic regression experiment illustrating how calibration can deteriorate on held-out groups. These results motivate reporting the evaluation population alongside a property estimate or compliance score.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.06953v1 公告类型：新
摘要：钢铁性能模型在随机测试分割上可以表现良好，即使它们对不熟悉的合金的推断效果不佳。 SteelAgent 将冶金描述符和机器学习模型与语言模型接口结合起来，用于性能预测、不确定性报告和逆向设计。我们研究了固定单元的选择如何改变 SteelBench 拉伸强度评估得出的结论。对于梯度提升，合并的非折叠 $R^2$ 从随机分割时的 0.859 下降到保留钢族时的 0.113。标称 90% 预测区间的经验覆盖范围为随机分割下的 91.0% 到保留源下的 37.6%。物理衍生特征的效果取决于评估。他们在 17 个家庭的保留分析中将梯度提升 $R^2$ 增加了 0.2534，并在单独的四年级实验室分析中将其减少了 0.358。我们报告了组级误差和综合回归实验，说明了保留组的校准如何恶化。这些结果促使报告评估群体以及财产估计或合规分数。
items.author: Aleksandr Volkov, Roman Sultimov, Mikhail Kuzin, Yury Maximov

items.title: Octopus: One Brain, Many Branches for Latent-KV Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
items.titleZh: Octopus：一个大脑，多个分支，用于潜在 KV 多智能体强化学习
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.06956v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems explore in parallel by spawning sub-agents with isolated context windows, whereas single-agent systems append every search and verification step into one growing trajectory. However, existing multi-agent frameworks duplicate prefix KV caches across branches, exchange findings by re-prefilling text summaries, and flatten or drop cross-branch dependencies during reinforcement learning (RL).
 We introduce Octopus, a single-model multi-agent RL framework in which all threads share one backbone and coordinate over a GPU-resident directed acyclic graph (DAG) of KV states through five primitives (fork, read_thread, wait_threads, rewind, commit). Octopus combines three co-designed mechanisms: (1) Zero-Copy Radix Forking, which spawns branches as $\mathcal{O}(1)$ cursor views over shared physical KV pages; (2) Attention-Only KV Mounting, which mounts a sibling thread's terminal KV blocks directly into full-attention layers while bypassing linear-recurrent states (Gated DeltaNet / Mamba-2), cutting off-task hijacking by $21\times$ ($57.9\% \to 2.7\%$) while retaining $92.2\%$ of full-text mutual information at zero extra KV allocation; and (3) a Packed DAG-GRPO Trainer, which packs all episode branches into one block-sparse attention pass and assigns counterfactual branch credit via leave-one-branch-out marginal rewards.
 Trained end-to-end with GRPO on Qwen3.5-4B over a sparse BM25 corpus, Octopus reaches $49.6\%$ accuracy on BrowseComp-Plus ($+17.5$ points over single-agent GRPO at 143K context and $+12.5$ points over text-summary multi-agent RL) and $51.2\%$ on OpenResearcher, outperforming dense-retrieval agents up to $250\times$ larger while increasing training throughput $3.3\times$ and cutting peak KV memory $2.8\times$.

arXiv:2611.06956v1 公告类型：新
摘要：多代理 LLM 系统通过生成具有隔离上下文窗口的子代理来并行探索，而单代理系统将每个搜索和验证步骤附加到一个增长轨迹中。然而，现有的多代理框架跨分支复制前缀 KV 缓存，通过重新预填充文本摘要来交换结果，并在强化学习 (RL) 期间压平或删除跨分支依赖关系。
 我们引入了 Octopus，一种单模型多代理 RL 框架，其中所有线程共享一个主干，并通过五个原语（fork、read_thread、wait_threads、rewind、commit）在 KV 状态的 GPU 驻留有向无环图（DAG）上进行协调。 Octopus 结合了三种共同设计的机制：（1）零复制基数分叉，它在共享物理 KV 页面上以 $\mathcal{O}(1)$ 光标视图的形式生成分支； (2) Attention-Only KV Mounting，将同级线程的终端 KV 块直接挂载到全注意力层中，同时绕过线性循环状态（Gated DeltaNet / Mamba-2），将任务劫持减少 $21\times$（$57.9\% \to 2.7\%$），同时在零额外 KV 分配的情况下保留 $92.2\%$ 的全文互信息； (3) 一个打包的 DAG-GRPO 训练器，它将所有情节分支打包到一个块稀疏注意力通道中，并通过留一分支边际奖励分配反事实分支信用。
 在 Qwen3.5-4B 上使用 GRPO 在稀疏 BM25 语料库上进行端到端训练，Octopus 在 BrowseComp-Plus 上达到 $49.6\%$ 准确率（在 143K 上下文中比单代理 GRPO 提高 $+17.5$ 点，在文本摘要多代理 RL 上提高 $+12.5$ 点），在 OpenResearcher 上达到 $51.2\%$ 准确率，优于密集检索代理最多增加 250 倍，同时训练吞吐量增加 3.3 倍，峰值 KV 内存减少 2.8 倍。

items.title: Uncertainty calibration in Bayesian M/EEG source imaging
items.titleZh: 贝叶斯 M/EEG 源成像的不确定性校准
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.06979v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: M/EEG source imaging requires accurate localization and reliable uncertainty estimates, yet posterior credible regions are rarely assessed for empirical calibration. We present a simulation-based framework for uncertainty quantification and calibration of empirical Bayesian inverse methods with closed-form conditional Gaussian posterior summaries. We compare Bayesian minimum norm (BMN) with sLORETA depth weighting and sparse Bayesian learning (SBL) with sparse basis field expansions (S-FLEX). S-FLEX allows retained coefficients to contribute nonzero marginal posterior variance at locations where voxel-wise SBL yields degenerate variances. For BMN, we derive joint source- and noise-variance updates through evidence maximization. We test whether adaptive noise learning yields near-calibrated uncertainties. Both methods retain residual miscalibration, motivating post-hoc isotonic recalibration of credible-region levels using empirical coverage. Simulations assess fixed- and free-orientation models across signal-to-noise ratios (SNR), source sparsity levels, and subject-specific head models, using oracle, baseline-estimated, and adaptively learned noise. Before recalibration, SBL+S-FLEX yields lower Wasserstein localization error, smaller posterior uncertainty, and coverage closer to nominal credibility than BMN+sLORETA. Isotonic recalibration improves both methods, with larger gains for conservative BMN+sLORETA posteriors; transfer across mismatched SNR, sparsity, and head models remains condition dependent. Noise specifications yield broadly consistent reconstruction and uncertainty trends within each estimator. In real auditory MEG data, SBL+S-FLEX provides more focal localization and tighter uncertainties than BMN+sLORETA, suggesting greater statistical power for identifying bilateral auditory sources.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.06979v1 公告类型：新
摘要：M/EEG 源成像需要准确的定位和可靠的不确定性估计，但很少评估后可信区域以进行经验校准。我们提出了一个基于模拟的框架，用于不确定性量化和校准具有封闭形式条件高斯后验总结的经验贝叶斯逆方法。我们将贝叶斯最小范数 (BMN) 与 sLORETA 深度加权以及稀疏贝叶斯学习 (SBL) 与稀疏基场扩展 (S-FLEX) 进行比较。 S-FLEX 允许保留系数在体素 SBL 产生简并方差的位置贡献非零边际后验方差。对于 BMN，我们通过证据最大化导出联合源方差和噪声方差更新。我们测试自适应噪声学习是否会产生接近校准的不确定性。两种方法都保留了残余误差校准，从而激发了使用经验覆盖率对可信区域水平进行事后等渗重新校准。模拟使用预言机、基线估计和自适应学习噪声来评估固定和自由方向模型的信噪比 (SNR)、源稀疏水平和特定于主题的头部模型。在重新校准之前，SBL+S-FLEX 比 BMN+sLORETA 产生更低的 Wasserstein 定位误差、更小的后验不确定性以及更接近名义可信度的覆盖范围。等张重新校准改进了两种方法，对于保守的 BMN+sLORETA 后验有更大的增益；跨不匹配的 SNR、稀疏性和头部模型的传输仍然依赖于条件。噪声规格在每个估计器内产生大致一致的重建和不确定性趋势。在真实的听觉 MEG 数据中，SBL+S-FLEX 比 BMN+sLORETA 提供更多的焦点定位和更严格的不确定性，这表明识别双边听觉源的统计能力更强。
items.author: Ismail Huseynov, Mohammad Orabe, Srikantan Nagarajan, Stefan Haufe

items.title: Big Models, Small Gains: Frozen Forecasters as Classifiers on MONSTER
items.titleZh: 大模型，小收获：冻结预报器作为 MONSTER 上的分类器
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.06988v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Forecasting foundation models are increasingly used as frozen feature extractors for time series classification, but it remains unclear whether their pretrained representations offer an advantage over strong classifiers that do not require pretraining. This raises an important question: do these representations provide useful information beyond what the model architecture alone can capture, particularly when labelled data are scarce? We present a controlled benchmarking of two forecasting models, Reverso and Chronos-Bolt, on six large datasets from the MONSTER benchmark, using 1%, 10%, and 100% of the available training labels. We compare their frozen representations against four established time series classification methods and random-weight versions of the same forecasting models. Our results show that pretraining improves classification accuracy over random-weight counterparts on five of the six datasets, with gains of up to 23 percentage points. However, the frozen representations do not reliably outperform the strongest non-pretrained baseline in any setting: they perform worse in 15 of 17 settings and tie in the remaining two. Further experiments show that restoring amplitude information recovers part of the performance gap, while fine-tuning and forecast-error features do not close it. These findings highlight the importance of strong task specific baselines and random weight controls when evaluating forecasting foundation models for classification. Our code is available at https://github.com/Rachet2006/frozen-forecasters-monster.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.06988v1 公告类型：新
摘要：预测基础模型越来越多地用作时间序列分类的冻结特征提取器，但仍不清楚它们的预训练表示是否比不需要预训练的强分类器具有优势。这就提出了一个重要的问题：这些表示是否提供了超出模型架构本身所能捕获的有用信息，特别是当标记数据稀缺时？我们使用 1%、10% 和 100% 的可用训练标签，在 MONSTER 基准测试的六个大型数据集上对两个预测模型（Reverso 和 Chronos-Bolt）进行受控基准测试。我们将它们的冻结表示与四种已建立的时间序列分类方法和相同预测模型的随机权重版本进行比较。我们的结果表明，在六个数据集中的五个数据集上，预训练比随机权重对应的分类准确性提高了高达 23 个百分点。然而，冻结表示在任何设置中都无法可靠地优于最强的非预训练基线：它们在 17 个设置中的 15 个设置中表现较差，而在其余两个设置中表现平平。进一步的实验表明，恢复幅度信息可以弥补部分性能差距，而微调和预测误差功能并不能弥补这一差距。这些发现强调了在评估分类预测基础模型时强大的任务特定基线和随机权重控制的重要性。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Rachet2006/frozen-forecasters-monster 获取。

items.title: Robust Stream Classification using Time Neutralising Decision Trees
items.titleZh: 使用时间中和决策树的鲁棒流分类
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.06991v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Data Streams are characterised as a potentially infinite source of data subject to non-stationarity. This non-stationarity, also called Concept Drift, often results in deployed predictive models having to be perpetually retrained as the underlying data generating process of the stream changes over time. Drift Detectors are a class of methods used to identify these changes, triggering these retraining procedures. Historically, Stream Learning has operated under the assumption that instances are only seen once, and cannot be stored for later use. Contemporary work relaxes this assumption, yet drift detection and simple resetting procedures are still ubiquitous.
 Building on related work which has shown that traditional Batch Learning algorithms often outperform Stream Learning algorithms when instances can be stored, we introduce Time Neutralising Trees (TNT), a Decision Tree architecture that enables robust stream classification in settings with Concept Drift. During training, TNT will filter out ("neutralise") old training samples that are no longer relevant given the current context of the stream. If those instances become relevant again, TNT will then re-include them. We evaluate TNT, and related algorithms on 24 real and semi-real classification data streams from the USP DS repository. Results show strong evidence that TNT achieves best-in-class performance on a wide-range of data streams with varying concept drift types.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.06991v1 公告类型：新
摘要：数据流的特点是潜在的无限数据源，具有非平稳性。这种非平稳性也称为概念漂移，通常会导致部署的预测模型必须不断地重新训练，因为流的底层数据生成过程会随着时间的推移而变化。漂移检测器是一类用于识别这些变化、触发这些再训练程序的方法。从历史上看，流学习的运行假设是实例只能看到一次，并且不能存储以供以后使用。当代的工作放松了这一假设，但漂移检测和简单的重置程序仍然普遍存在。
 相关工作表明，当可以存储实例时，传统的批量学习算法通常优于流学习算法，我们在此基础上引入了时间中和树 (TNT)，这是一种决策树架构，可在概念漂移的设置中实现稳健的流分类。在训练期间，TNT 将过滤掉（“中和”）与当前流上下文不再相关的旧训练样本。如果这些实例再次变得相关，TNT 将重新包含它们。我们在 USP DS 存储库的 24 个真实和半真实分类数据流上评估 TNT 和相关算法。结果有力地证明，TNT 在具有不同概念漂移类型的各种数据流上实现了一流的性能。

items.title: LowRAM: Low-Rank Keys and Amortised Values for Composable KV Cache Compression at Test-Time
items.titleZh: LowRAM：测试时可组合 KV 缓存压缩的低等级键和摊余值
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.07025v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Autoregressive decoding relies on the KV cache, whose memory footprint grows linearly with context length and caps batch size and throughput. Existing post-training methods exploit redundancy across tokens, layers, and feature dimensions, or lower numerical precision. We identify a complementary axis: within each attention head, values are largely predictable from their corresponding keys. We exploit this with value cache amortisation, which fits a lightweight per-head predictor at test time and stores residuals only for the tokens it reconstructs worst, giving $4\times$ near-lossless value compression. The predictor can be initialised by meta-learning for substantially reduced prefill overhead, or fitted from scratch in settings that allow a one-off cost, such as multi-query inference. We pair value amortisation with cross-layer low-rank key compression to produce LowRAM, an asymmetric compression pipeline that stays close to lossless across three model families. By reconstructing only a selected subset of KV pairs at each decoding step, LowRAM can keep decoding overhead minimal and achieve up to $5\times$ higher peak decode throughput at $4\times$ compression. LowRAM further composes with quantisation and eviction, reaching $26.9\times$ compression at $94.5\%$ of baseline performance on long contexts. These results show that treating keys and values as structurally distinct enables efficient, aggressive, and composable KV cache compression.

摘要：自回归解码依赖于 KV 缓存，其内存占用量随着上下文长度线性增长，并限制批量大小和吞吐量。现有的后训练方法利用令牌、层和特征维度之间的冗余，或较低的数值精度。我们确定了一个互补轴：在每个注意力头中，值在很大程度上可以根据其相应的键来预测。我们通过价值缓存摊销来利用这一点，它在测试时适合轻量级的每头预测器，并仅存储其重建最差的令牌的残差，从而提供 4\times$ 近乎无损的价值压缩。预测器可以通过元学习来初始化，以显着减少预填充开销，或者在允许一次性成本的设置中从头开始安装，例如多查询推理。我们将价值摊销与跨层低秩密钥压缩结合起来，生成 LowRAM，这是一种非对称压缩管道，在三个模型系列中都保持接近无损。通过在每个解码步骤中仅重建选定的 KV 对子集，LowRAM 可以将解码开销保持在最低限度，并在 4\times$ 压缩下实现高达 $5\times$ 的峰值解码吞吐量。 LowRAM 进一步结合量化和逐出，在长上下文中达到 $26.9\times$ 压缩，基准性能为 $94.5\%$。这些结果表明，将键和值视为结构上不同的键和值可以实现高效、积极且可组合的 KV 缓存压缩。

items.title: Stochastic Dynamics of Generative AI: From Autoregressive Models to Interacting LLM Networks and Neural SDEs
items.titleZh: 生成式人工智能的随机动力学：从自回归模型到交互 LLM 网络和神经 SDE
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.07065v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: This paper develops a stochastic dynamical-systems perspective on three classes of generative AI models. First, we formulate large language models (LLMs) as high-dimensional nonlinear autoregressive models with attention-based dependencies. This formulation connects pretraining by conditional maximum likelihood to sequential token generation and provides a probabilistic interpretation of LLM operation. Second, we consider networks of interacting LLMs and characterize their collective behavior through mean-field ordinary differential equations. These dynamics provide a framework for understanding emergent preferential attachment and persistent structural biases, including type-dependent glass-ceiling effects. Third, we consider neural stochastic differential equations (SDEs) as continuous-time generative models for stochastic trajectories, including those observed at irregular time intervals. We discuss their training with particular emphasis on Wiener-space cubature methods based on rough-path analysis as an efficient alternative to Monte Carlo estimation. Together, the three settings address probabilistic prediction, information exchange and emergent behavior in interacting networks, and path-space generative modeling.

摘要：本文对三类生成人工智能模型提出了随机动力系统的观点。首先，我们将大型语言模型（LLM）制定为具有基于注意力的依赖性的高维非线性自回归模型。该公式将条件最大似然的预训练与顺序令牌生成联系起来，并提供 LLM 操作的概率解释。其次，我们考虑相互作用的法学硕士网络，并通过平均场常微分方程来表征它们的集体行为。这些动态提供了一个框架，用于理解新兴的偏好依恋和持久的结构偏差，包括类型相关的玻璃天花板效应。第三，我们将神经随机微分方程（SDE）视为随机轨迹的连续时间生成模型，包括以不规则时间间隔观察到的轨迹。我们讨论了他们的训练，特别强调基于粗糙路径分析的维纳空间体积方法，作为蒙特卡罗估计的有效替代方法。这三种设置共同解决了交互网络中的概率预测、信息交换和紧急行为以及路径空间生成建模。

items.title: Finite-Time Convergence and Regret Guarantees for Neural Reinforcement Learning in POMDPs
items.titleZh: POMDP 中神经强化学习的有限时间收敛和遗憾保证
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.07069v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) in Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (POMDPs) is computationally challenging due to the curse of long-range dependence on history. Fortunately, recent studies have shown that a range of POMDPs that satisfy the filter stability assumption can be well approximated by a superstate Markov Decision Process (MDP) based on a truncated history in a finite-memory window, with a value gap that decays with the window length. However, existing finite-time convergence analyses on such superstate MDP surrogates are either limited to over-simplified linear function approximation or rely on an i.i.d. sampling oracle that is violated by POMDP trajectories, both of which severely limit the applicability of these theoretical results in practice. This motivates us to bridge the gap by investigating RL in POMDPs with nonlinear neural value function approximation. Our main contributions are threefold: i) We first establish a new finite-state MDP point-wise approximation error bound, which lays the foundation for our RL algorithm design and analysis in POMDPs; ii) By applying Temporal-Difference (TD) learning to POMDP-generated superstate transitions and targeting the Bellman fixed point of the superstate MDP, we prove a finite-time critic error bound with nonlinear neural value function approximation; and iii) By combining the neural critic function approximation error bound with the policy mirror descent framework, we obtain a finite-time sublinear regret against the optimal POMDP value. To the best of our knowledge, such a finite-time sublinear regret based on neural function approximation is the first in the literature for finite-memory POMDPs. Our numerical experiments also verify our theoretical results.

摘要：由于长期依赖历史的诅咒，部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）中的强化学习（RL）在计算上具有挑战性。幸运的是，最近的研究表明，满足滤波器稳定性假设的一系列 POMDP 可以通过基于有限内存窗口中截断历史的超级马尔可夫决策过程 (MDP) 来很好地近似，其值差距随着窗口长度而衰减。然而，现有的对此类超级 MDP 代理的有限时间收敛分析要么仅限于过度简化的线性函数近似，要么依赖于独立同分布。 POMDP 轨迹违反了采样预言，这两者都严重限制了这些理论结果在实践中的适用性。这促使我们通过使用非线性神经值函数逼近研究 POMDP 中的 RL 来弥补这一差距。我们的主要贡献有三个：i）我们首先建立了一个新的有限状态 MDP 逐点逼近误差界，这为我们在 POMDP 中的 RL 算法设计和分析奠定了基础； ii) 通过将时差（TD）学习应用于 POMDP 生成的超状态转移，并针对超状态 MDP 的贝尔曼不动点，我们证明了具有非线性神经值函数近似的有限时间临界误差界； iii) 通过将神经批评函数逼近误差界与策略镜像下降框架相结合，我们获得了针对最优 POMDP 值的有限时间次线性遗憾。据我们所知，这种基于神经函数近似的有限时间亚线性后悔是有限内存 POMDP 文献中的第一个。我们的数值实验也验证了我们的理论结果。

items.title: Shaping & Monitoring Models through their Internal Representations
items.titleZh: 通过内部表征塑造和监控模型
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.07071v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: We propose Mechanistic Shaping, a unified framework for shaping models through their internal representations. Mechanistic Shaping is applied during training so that models follow specifications (rules) about which concepts they express, measured via their outputs or internal representations (e.g., no harmful content), and also which concepts they rely on, i.e., what they use to make their decisions (e.g., not a candidate's gender when screening a r\'esum\'e). Across multiple domains (vision, medical imaging, language), scales (up to 32B parameters), and training paradigms (classification, SFT, DPO, GRPO), we find that Mechanistic Shaping substantially reduces targeted behaviors while preserving task performance. Since training against a representation can also modify it, we ask whether shaped concepts remain monitorable, a question that depends on the class of monitors considered. We therefore introduce a hierarchy of such classes, which separates a concept that escapes one probe from a concept that is truly gone. We characterize three geometric mechanisms of circumvention: the concept can drift away from the monitor, be erased from the layer, or persist in higher-order statistics as a nonlinear encoding, which we explain through a product-code construction. Although other mechanisms may arise in different settings or at larger scales, these three account for all of our observations, and each can be detected by a matching monitor. In practice, we find that shaped concepts largely remain monitorable: refitted linear probes recover the concept in most settings, and the original probe remains reliable whenever gradients do not flow through it. Taken together, these results point to the potential of using interpretability as a tool for training, and call for a correspondingly rigorous science of interpretability-based training.

items.title: Optimistic Hedge in General-Sum Games: Fundamental Limits and Regret Bounds via Temporal Approximation
items.titleZh: 总和博弈中的乐观对冲：通过时间近似的基本限制和遗憾界限
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.07078v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Optimistic Hedge, a multiplicative weight update with one step of extrapolation, is one of the most natural regret-minimizing dynamics for games, and characterizing its regret has been a longstanding open question. Daskalakis, Fishelson and Golowich proved that if all $m$ players in a finite general-sum game follow Optimistic Hedge with a fixed learning rate, each player's regret is polylogarithmic in the horizon $T$. Subsequently, Ha showed that an appropriate choice of learning rate makes each player's regret bounded independently of $T$. This bound, however, is non-constructive and its dependence on the number of actions $n$ is not explicit, leaving open whether Optimistic Hedge can achieve a constant regret bound which is polynomial in the size of the game.
 We show that the answer hinges on the number of players. In two-player games, there is a learning rate for which Optimistic Hedge guarantees $O(n\log n)$ regret independent of the horizon. In three-player games, however, no such bound is possible: for any learning rate up to an absolute constant and for sufficiently large horizon $T$, there is a game with $n$ actions per player in which some player's regret is $2^{\Omega(n)}$, and more generally, for every $m\ge3$ we construct $m$-player games in which some player's regret is $2^{\Omega(mn)}$; for learning rates above $2^{-\Omega(mn)}$, that player's regret even grows linearly in $T$.
 Our upper bound is based on a temporal approximation framework for the analysis of Optimistic Hedge. Starting from the variance-based RVU bound of Daskalakis et al., we approximate the losses over time-localized windows by well-behaved functions, whose total variation is a small fraction of their cumulative variance. In $m$-player games, the same framework gives a significantly simplified proof of the recent $O(\sqrt{m}\log n\log T)$ regret bound due to Ha.

摘要：乐观对冲是一种具有一步外推的乘法权重更新，是游戏中最自然的后悔最小化动态之一，而表征其后悔一直是一个长期悬而未决的问题。 Daskalakis、Fishelson 和 Golowich 证明，如果有限一般和游戏中的所有 $m$ 玩家都遵循固定学习率的乐观对冲，则每个玩家的遗憾在地平线 $T$ 中是多对数的。随后，Ha 表明，适当选择学习率可以使每个玩家的后悔程度独立于 $T$。然而，这个界限是非建设性的，并且它对动作数量 $n$ 的依赖性并不明确，因此乐观对冲是否可以实现恒定的遗憾界限（该界限是游戏规模的多项式）尚不确定。
 我们表明答案取决于玩家的数量。在两人游戏中，存在一个学习率，乐观对冲可以保证 $O(n\log n)$ 后悔，而与范围无关。然而，在三人游戏中，这样的界限是不可能的：对于任何高达绝对常数的学习率和足够大的视野$T$，存在每个玩家有$n$个动作的游戏，其中一些玩家的遗憾是$2^{\Omega(n)}$，更一般地，对于每个$m\ge3$，我们构造$m$个玩家游戏，其中一些玩家的遗憾是$2^{\Omega(mn)}$；对于高于 $2^{-\Omega(mn)}$ 的学习率，该玩家的遗憾甚至会以 $T$ 线性增长。

items.title: Server-Side Sparse Assignment for Federated Mixture-of-Experts
items.titleZh: 联合专家混合的服务器端稀疏分配
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.07093v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly recognized for their remarkable capabilities; federated learning (FL) offers a promising framework for collaboratively fine-tuning LLMs on edge devices while achieving data privacy. However, edge devices are inherently heterogeneous: clients may exhibit diverse data distributions and resource constraints, including limited memory and computation budgets. Recent federated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) approaches address these challenges by using sparse expert activation or partial expert loading. However, existing partial-expert methods rely on heuristic full-pool observations or prioritize system-wide load balance, without guarantees for recovering client-specific relevant experts from partial observations. We propose $S^3$-MoE, a server-side sparse expert assignment framework that estimates client-specific expert relevance from partial observations and refines assignments through an exploit--explore mechanism. We also establish relevance-estimation error and exact Top-$K$ recovery guarantees. Experiments using a CNN-based MoE on CIFAR-100 show that $S^3$-MoE recovers task-dependent client--expert preferences and reduces conflicts caused by correlated expert selection across clients. Compared with Full-20 FedAvg, which gives each client access to all 20 experts for local Top-5 routing, $S^3$-MoE achieves 1.31 percentage points higher mean final accuracy while loading only $5$ experts per client.

items.title: A Night at the LLM Zoo: Data Conditioned Flow Matching for Generating Pretrained LLM Weights
items.titleZh: LLM Zoo 之夜：用于生成预训练 LLM 权重的数据条件流匹配
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.07103v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: A challenge to Weight Space Learning as it expands from task specific and vision models to Large Language Models (LLMs) is the absence of a well curated and analyzed LLM population. To address this, we train such a model zoo for application to Weight Space Generation by systematically varying the data mixture composition between web text, books, mathematics, coding, and French across populations of 51M, 124M, and 355M parameter GPT-2 Models, each tier with count N = 100. We analyze these populations by cosine similarity, functional diversity, Leave-One-Mixture-Out modeling, and variance decomposition. We show that the zoo contains diverse models whose variation is structured by training mixture composition. We embed the training mixture composition to condition a Flow Matching model of complete pretrained LLM weights in Gram-PCA compressed weight space. By demonstrating zero-shot generalization to held out mixtures, measuring Continuous Ranked Probability Score skill, as well as finding minimal changes in downstream test-set perplexity and general capability benchmark scores, we show that our generator generalizes on the simplex of data mixtures to produce models that perform similarly to those in the zoo ex nihilo. Finally, we produce all source code and artifacts to support the continued expansion of Weight Space Learning and Generation into the LLM domain.

摘要：权重空间学习从特定任务和视觉模型扩展到大型语言模型 (LLM) 时面临的挑战是缺乏精心策划和分析的 LLM 群体。为了解决这个问题，我们通过在 51M、124M 和 355M 参数 GPT-2 模型群体（每层计数 N = 100）中系统地改变网络文本、书籍、数学、编码和法语之间的数据混合组成来训练这样一个模型动物园，用于权重空间生成。我们通过余弦相似性、功能多样性、留一混合模型和方差分解来分析这些群体。我们证明动物园包含多种模型，其变化是通过训练混合物组成来构建的。我们嵌入训练混合物组合物，以在 Gram-PCA 压缩权重空间中调节完整预训练 LLM 权重的流匹配模型。通过演示零样本泛化以支持混合，测量连续排名概率得分技能，以及发现下游测试集困惑度和一般能力基准分数的最小变化，我们表明我们的生成器在数据混合的单纯形上进行泛化，以生成与动物园中的模型类似的模型。最后，我们生成所有源代码和工件，以支持权重空间学习和生成继续扩展到法学硕士领域。

items.title: Regulating Autonomous Mobility-on-Demand Operators with Fixed and Adaptive Penalties: A Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Approach
items.titleZh: 用固定和自适应惩罚来监管自主按需移动运营商：一种多智能体强化学习方法
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.07122v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Profit-maximizing Autonomous Mobility-on-Demand (AMoD) operators may exploit consumer surplus through excessive prices and underserve less profitable regions by relocating vehicles away from them. We study how penalty-based regulation of an AMoD operator in a multimodal mobility system can limit surge pricing and improve regional service availability. We model regulation as an outer control loop that acts on a learning-based operator. Static regulation with fixed penalties is formulated as a Markov Decision Process for an operator that jointly controls pricing and rebalancing, and dynamic regulation as a Partially Observable Stochastic Game in which a regulator periodically adjusts region-specific penalties in closed loop. Operator and regulator policies are learned with graph-based multi-agent reinforcement learning. In experiments with real-world Manhattan data, fixed surge pricing penalties reduce the share of travelers facing excessive prices from 22% to 1%. For regional service availability, dynamic regulation improves the regulator's reward by up to 15.6% over fixed penalties of equal mean intensity. The gains in service availability are strongest when spare fleet capacity exists, whereas service deficits persist in peak periods with highly utilized fleets. The learned regulator policy responds by reducing penalties where limited fleet capacity restricts compliance. The results identify trade-offs between regulatory targets, operator profitability, and traveler utility.

arXiv:2611.07122v1 公告类型：新
摘要：追求利润最大化的自主按需出行（AMoD）运营商可能会通过过高的价格来利用消费者剩余，并通过将车辆从利润较低的地区移走而导致服务不足。我们研究了多式联运系统中 AMoD 运营商的基于惩罚的监管如何限制激增定价并提高区域服务可用性。我们将调节建模为作用于基于学习的算子的外部控制环。具有固定处罚的静态监管被制定为共同控制定价和再平衡的运营商的马尔可夫决策过程，而动态监管则被制定为部分可观察随机博弈，其中监管机构定期调整闭环中特定区域的处罚。运营商和监管机构的政策是通过基于图的多智能体强化学习来学习的。在曼哈顿真实数据的实验中，固定的峰时定价处罚将面临价格过高的旅行者比例从 22% 降低到 1%。对于区域服务可用性，动态监管比同等平均强度的固定处罚将监管者的奖励提高了 15.6%。当存在备用机队容量时，服务可用性的收益最为强劲，而在机队利用率高的高峰期，服务赤字持续存在。经验丰富的监管机构政策的反应是减少因车队容量有限而限制合规性的处罚。结果确定了监管目标、运营商盈利能力和旅客效用之间的权衡。

items.title: Machine Learning for Live-Birth Prediction After IVF/ICSI From Structured Clinical Data: A Systematic Review, Meta-Analysis, and Critical Appraisal
items.titleZh: 根据结构化临床数据进行 IVF/ICSI 后活产预测的机器学习：系统回顾、荟萃分析和批判性评估
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.07124v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Machine-learning models predicting live birth after in vitro fertilisation (IVF) or intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) from routine clinical data report performance from near chance to near perfect. We systematically reviewed these models under PRISMA 2020, searching OpenAlex, Scopus and Web of Science to 22 October 2026, appraised them with PROBAST+AI and TRIPOD+AI, and pooled their discrimination with random-effects meta-analysis on the logit scale. We define what fixes the meaning of a model's output (decision point, endpoint, unit of analysis, data source) and map the 48 included studies by model family, decision point and validation design. Models evaluated only internally pooled to an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.814, against 0.756 (95% prediction interval 0.546-0.889) for models evaluated on a later period or another centre, and 0.764 for studies not at high risk of bias; neither difference was significant, and heterogeneity was extreme. Models whose decision point was not stated pooled to 0.910, the only significant moderator in meta-regression. Against logistic regression fitted to the same data, the best machine-learning model gained a pooled 0.056 AUC (95% CI 0.017-0.090). Of 48 studies, 47 were at high or unclear risk of bias, only four assessed the calibration slope, and no model has evidence of clinical impact. The certainty of the pooled evidence is low to very low; the gains that survive validation came from staging predictions to decision points and local calibration, not deeper architectures. We provide a TRIPOD+AI-mapped checklist, a benchmark specification and a research agenda.

摘要：根据常规临床数据预测体外受精 (IVF) 或胞浆内单精子注射 (ICSI) 后的活产的机器学习模型报告的表现从接近机会到接近完美。我们在 PRISMA 2020 下系统地回顾了这些模型，检索了 OpenAlex、Scopus 和 Web of Science 截至 2026 年 10 月 22 日，用 PROBAST+AI 和 TRIPOD+AI 对其进行了评估，并将它们的判别力与 Logit 量表上的随机效应荟萃分析进行了汇总。我们定义了模型输出的含义（决策点、终点、分析单元、数据源），并按模型系列、决策点和验证设计绘制了 48 项纳入的研究。模型仅内部评估，受试者工作特征曲线 (AUC) 下的面积为 0.814，而在较晚时期或另一个中心评估的模型为 0.756（95% 预测区间 0.546-0.889），对于不存在高偏倚风险的研究为 0.764；两种差异均不显着，且异质性极大。未说明决策点的模型汇总为 0.910，这是元回归中唯一重要的调节因子。与拟合相同数据的逻辑回归相比，最好的机器学习模型获得了 0.056 AUC（95% CI 0.017-0.090）。在 48 项研究中，47 项存在较高或不明确的偏倚风险，只有 4 项评估了校准斜率，并且没有模型具有临床影响的证据。汇总证据的质量从低到极低；经过验证的收益来自于将预测分阶段部署到决策点和局部校准，而不是更深层次的架构。我们提供 TRIPOD+AI 映射清单、基准规范和研究议程。

items.title: Data-Driven Modeling of Molten Chloride Corrosion Using Static Test Data
items.titleZh: 使用静态测试数据进行熔融氯化物腐蚀的数据驱动建模
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.07125v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Molten chloride corrosion has been studied for decades, yet reliable prediction across different alloys, salts, and test conditions remains difficult. In this work, 291 static molten chloride corrosion experiments reported in the literature were compiled into a structured dataset and used to develop an interpretable machine-learning framework for corrosion-rate predictions. To better represent the differences in salt condition across studies, a Chloride Salt Preparation Index (CSPI) was introduced to bring the reported salt-treatment method, atmosphere control, and pre-exposure impurity condition on a common numerical scale. A blended tree-based ensemble provided the most consistent predictive performance, achieving a cross-validated \(R^2\) of 0.85 and an MAE of 0.41 mg cm\(^{-2}\) day\(^{-1}\). The graded CSPI retained more useful information than a simple purified/unpurified classification and emerged as the dominant model descriptor. Global sensitivity and SHAP analyses further identified exposure time, temperature, and alloy chemistry as important contributors to the model predictions, with several observed trends consistent with the established molten-chloride corrosion behavior. The conformal prediction intervals were well calibrated, providing an estimate of prediction uncertainty in addition to the point prediction. Overall, the framework demonstrates that historical corrosion data can support quantitative, interpretable, and uncertainty-aware prediction when experimental context is represented explicitly, while also highlighting where more consistent reporting and targeted experiments are needed to improve future molten-salt corrosion models.

arXiv:2611.07125v1 公告类型：新
摘要：熔融氯化物腐蚀的研究已经有几十年了，但对不同合金、盐和测试条件的可靠预测仍然很困难。在这项工作中，文献中报道的 291 个静态熔融氯化物腐蚀实验被编译成结构化数据集，并用于开发用于腐蚀速率预测的可解释的机器学习框架。为了更好地表示研究中盐条件的差异，引入了氯化物盐制备指数 (CSPI)，将报告的盐处理方法、气氛控制和曝光前杂质条件纳入通用的数值范围。基于混合树的集成提供了最一致的预测性能，实现了 0.85 的交叉验证 \(R^2\) 和 0.41 mg cm\(^{-2}\) day\(^{-1}\) 的 MAE。分级 CSPI 比简单的纯化/未纯化分类保留了更多有用的信息，并成为主要的模型描述符。全局灵敏度和 SHAP 分析进一步确定了暴露时间、温度和合金化学成分是模型预测的重要因素，其中一些观察到的趋势与已建立的熔融氯化物腐蚀行为一致。共形预测区间得到了很好的校准，除了点预测之外，还提供了预测不确定性的估计。总体而言，该框架表明，当明确表示实验背景时，历史腐蚀数据可以支持定量、可解释和不确定性感知的预测，同时还强调需要更一致的报告和有针对性的实验来改进未来的熔盐腐蚀模型。
